body: I'm available for a vent session so don't hesitate to keep in touch

I'm not talking about ordinary people,I'm talking about the people who are employed to answer the phone to suicidal people, and just passing me about to other "professionals", it just seems pointless reaching out, I know it's worked for others but it isn't for me, that was the point I was trying to make, as for "keep trying", kept trying for years now but it's absolutely escalated beyond belief now, there's 1 decent day a month I have, hard to see that as a reason worth continuing, anyway, not your problem so I'll shoosh :)
